# Knowledge map: ILCE-6400A qualification and firmware acquisition

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/a6400a-acquisition.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** The ILCE-6400A 1.01 reference target: native debugger boundary, kernel/partition map, Jiritsu/Senser service packets, DMM fixtures, MISCREG/eFuse and the read-only partition captures.
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-22.
- **Deep review:** 0 of 20 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Frontier

### <a id="f01"></a>F01 - Remaining ILCE-6400A flash boundary

- **State:** `open`
- **Next:** Excluded nflasha23 and the whole-device image remain; mounted partitions are non-atomic snapshots. Any further capture needs an explicit scope decision, not a weakened guard.
- **Evidence:** [E0643](../evidence/0643-cxd90045-miscreg-efuse-and-a6400a-jiritsu-chunk-planner.md), [E0675](../evidence/0675-a6400a-expanded-bootstrap-review-and-full-dump-boundary.md)

## Hazards (read before any camera run)

| ID | Hazard | Effect | Rule | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="h01"></a>H01 | Lowering the reader memory guard | Free memory below the 8-MiB floor risks the live camera during transfers. | Keep the 8,192-KiB guard; reclaim page cache read-only (POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED) instead of lowering it. | [E0643](../evidence/0643-cxd90045-miscreg-efuse-and-a6400a-jiritsu-chunk-planner.md) |
| <a id="h02"></a>H02 | Service-mode side effects | Native feature 7 can delete/back up configuration before a getter; Ghidra shows internal-flash effects before the Jiritsu library load. | No speculative loader, driver change or mode entry; review body-specific entry and cleanup contracts first. | [E0669](../evidence/0669-a6400a-offline-senser-dispatch-and-native-read-gates.md), [E0675](../evidence/0675-a6400a-expanded-bootstrap-review-and-full-dump-boundary.md) |

## Entities

### <a id="body-ilce6400a"></a>ILCE-6400A firmware 1.01 (reference target)

`body.ilce6400a` | usb-identity

Second a6400 variant qualified as a reference target: kernel 8.2.7.6, Mass Storage identity verified natively; no root debugger.

Aliases: `054C:0F0F`, `8.2.7.6`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `PHYSICAL` ILCE-6400A 1.01 was qualified as a reference target with its kernel, partition, MMIO and emulator-hook map; the native read-only transport hit an unresolved model-info BUSY before MSC reply lifetime fixes verified the native identity. ([E0506](../evidence/0506-a6400a-offline-qualification-and-debugger-boundary.md), [E0507](../evidence/0507-a6400a-kernel-partition-mmio-and-hook-map.md), [E0508](../evidence/0508-a6400a-native-readonly-transport-and-model-info-busy.md), [E0509](../evidence/0509-a6400a-msc-reply-lifetime-and-verified-native-identity.md))
- **C05** `PHYSICAL` Bounded debugger ioctl fixtures pass, but feature 0x23 returns 05/20/00 with no data; repeated live Senser authentication works and the bounded file request returns 0xFF01 / status 0x80 with zero payload. ([E0667](../evidence/0667-a6400a-debugger-abi-and-live-channel-boundary.md), [E0668](../evidence/0668-a6400a-live-senser-entry-and-recovery.md))

### <a id="proc-jiritsu-senser"></a>Jiritsu / Senser service packets

`proc.jiritsu-senser` | process | inventory `firmware.elf:nflasha15_unpacked/lib/libJiritsu.so`

Sony service-mode routing (Jiritsu) with Senser encoding: offline packet fixtures, live authenticated entry, file-read refusal and the fixed nflasha5 reader route.

Aliases: `libJiritsu`, `GET_FILE`, `0xFF01`, `RAM_READ`

Current knowledge:

- **C02** `OFFLINE` Jiritsu routing and Senser encoding reproduce offline packet fixtures; explicit DMM fixtures cover 24-byte metadata, share/open counters and bounded borrowed replies to a memory-only sink, with USB disabled. ([E0525](../evidence/0525-a6400a-jiritsu-senser-offline-packets.md), [E0532](../evidence/0532-a6400a-dmm-metadata-bounds-and-lifetime.md))
- **C03** `OFFLINE` ILCE-6400A nflasha5 is a WBI1 image that names Jiritsu, and 1.01 libJiritsu dispatches GET_FILE on halfword 8. ([E0552](../evidence/0552-a6400a-nflasha5-wbi-jiritsu-names.md), [E0554](../evidence/0554-a6400a-v101-jiritsu-command-dispatch.md))
- **C05** `PHYSICAL` Bounded debugger ioctl fixtures pass, but feature 0x23 returns 05/20/00 with no data; repeated live Senser authentication works and the bounded file request returns 0xFF01 / status 0x80 with zero payload. ([E0667](../evidence/0667-a6400a-debugger-abi-and-live-channel-boundary.md), [E0668](../evidence/0668-a6400a-live-senser-entry-and-recovery.md))
- **C06** `OFFLINE` Offline Senser dispatch reproduces the missing-handler 0x80 decision; Ghidra finds a level-3 fallback to a fixed read-only /dev/nflasha5 callback; fixed-reader framing and completion controls and a guarded acquisition client were built without weakening FF01 guards. ([E0669](../evidence/0669-a6400a-offline-senser-dispatch-and-native-read-gates.md), [E0670](../evidence/0670-a6400a-ghidra-reader-consumers-and-fixed-partition-candidate.md), [E0671](../evidence/0671-a6400a-fixed-reader-framing-and-completion-controls.md), [E0672](../evidence/0672-a6400a-guarded-fixed-acquisition-and-supervised-gate.md))

### <a id="proc-partition-capture"></a>Read-only partition capture

`proc.partition-capture` | process

Captures of ILCE-6400A partitions through guarded readers: first nflasha5 (62,914,560 bytes), MSC LUN 1, then all 17 allowed nonzero nflasha partitions.

Aliases: `nflasha5`, `msc-lun1.bin`, `plan-chunk-dump`

Current knowledge:

- **C04** `PHYSICAL` Neither DGU5 nor the ILCE-6400 / ILCE-6400A kernels verify kernel signatures; live MISCREG/eFuse values were read with a bounded single-page /dev/mem probe; a single-slot <= 512 KiB chunk planner was added. ([E0643](../evidence/0643-cxd90045-miscreg-efuse-and-a6400a-jiritsu-chunk-planner.md))
- **C07** `PHYSICAL` The first real ILCE-6400A nflasha5 partition was captured (62,914,560 bytes, SHA-256 d131b73f...) with independent host readback agreement; STOP remained unacknowledged. ([E0673](../evidence/0673-a6400a-first-actual-nflasha5-capture.md))
- **C08** `PHYSICAL` 2,097,152 genuine MSC LUN 1 bytes were saved through unchanged USBSTOR (SHA-256 824fb214...); the matching-size nflasha23 backing is unattested. An expanded review obtained no further bytes. ([E0674](../evidence/0674-a6400a-readonly-msc-lun-capture-and-flash-boundary.md), [E0675](../evidence/0675-a6400a-expanded-bootstrap-review-and-full-dump-boundary.md))
- **C09** `PHYSICAL` A native reader captured and SHA-256 verified all 17 allowed nonzero nflasha partitions (1,354,694,656 bytes) without lowering the 8-MiB memory guard; nflasha5 matches E0673 bit for bit. nflasha23 and the whole device stay unacquired, and mounted partitions are live snapshots. ([E0643](../evidence/0643-cxd90045-miscreg-efuse-and-a6400a-jiritsu-chunk-planner.md))

### <a id="soc-miscreg-efuse"></a>MISCREG / eFuse MMIO

`soc.miscreg-efuse` | device | address `0xF2915000`

Live ILCE-6400 MISCREG/eFuse values 0xF2915000 = 0x00000500 and 0xF2915010 = 0x0c01002b read with a bounded single-page /dev/mem probe.

Current knowledge:

- **C04** `PHYSICAL` Neither DGU5 nor the ILCE-6400 / ILCE-6400A kernels verify kernel signatures; live MISCREG/eFuse values were read with a bounded single-page /dev/mem probe; a single-slot <= 512 KiB chunk planner was added. ([E0643](../evidence/0643-cxd90045-miscreg-efuse-and-a6400a-jiritsu-chunk-planner.md))
